text:
maria: Quick question — I need to push a hotfix image (service-api:1.2.3 -> 1.2.4). Can we do an image-only rollout by passing --set image.tag=1.2.4 in CI, or are we required to bump the chart version?

deploy-bot: preflight check failed: values-schema validation blocked upgrade. chart_version is pinned for this release window. See CI job: https://ci.internal/reports/12345 (error: values.chartPinned=true)

kevin: we usually allow image.tag overrides via values, but the pinning was added last quarter to avoid silent chart changes during enterprise deployments. If chart_version is enforced the helm pipeline refuses upgrades that don't match pinnedChart in repo.

maria: ugh. I didn't realize the pin would block image-only. Is there a safe way to do a hotfix without a full chart bump?

alejandra: two options: 1) do a minor chart version bump + release notes (slow, but tracked), or 2) do a direct k8s patch to the Deployment (kubectl set image) for an emergency hotfix — but that diverges from helm state and complicates rollbacks. Preference for #1 unless it's a critical P0.

kevin: agree. If it's latency or security P0, we can do emergency patch then follow up with a chart bump and reconcile. If not P0, we should open a tiny chart bump PR and roll it through the normal canary.

maria: it's a user-facing N1 (login failure for some customers) — not full outage, but urgent. I can open a chart bump PR, but CI windows mean it won't land until tomorrow's change window. Can we do a canary emergency patch?

sre-oncall: For emergency canary we can allow a manual override of pin for a single deploy with oncall approval. Procedure: create a flagged CI run with label emergency=true, @sre-oncall will approve, and we run helm upgrade --atomic --timeout 10m --set image.tag=1.2.4 --values emergency-values.yaml. This still uses helm so state remains consistent.

maria: ok that sounds good. What's the exact command so I don't screw the canary flags up?

ci-cd-bot: example command (run from release pipeline template):
```
helm upgrade svc-api ./charts/service-api \
  --namespace prod --reuse-values \
  --set image.tag=1.2.4 \
  --set release.emergency=true \
  --atomic --timeout 10m \
  -f ci/emergency-values.yaml
```
Note: pipeline will attach a flagged deployment and set pinnedChartSkip=true for a single run if emergency=true and approved by oncall.

kevin: post-deploy checklist: monitor latency/5xx QPS for 15m, verify smoke tests, and file the chart bump PR to reconcile Helm repo (PR title: "chore(service-api): bump chart to 0.14.3 - emergency image patch"). If rollback needed, we revert image tag via helm rollback <REV>.

maria: I'll open the emergency run now and ping @sre-oncall. Thanks — will follow the checklist and create the chart bump PR after canary. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: approved for emergency. Run the flagged pipeline and I'll watch the canary. :eyes:

maria: starting pipeline -> https://ci.internal/runs/67890

ci-cd-bot: deploy started, canary subset: 5%, target deploy group: prod/eu-west-1, run id 67890.

maria: canary passed smoke (login + token refresh) at t+9m. Scaling to 50% now.

kevin: good. keep monitoring for 30m, then we can finish rollout if stable. Also remind to add release notes: "hotfix: fix login token expiry for subset of users" and link chart bump PR when opened.

maria: will do. Thanks everyone. :shipit:
